concepts.learning_objective: Describe the situation in which the speaker telephones a landlady about renting accommodation.
Explain the irony of the speaker having to 'confess' that he is African.

topics.title: The landlady's response and racial prejudice

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret the images that reveal the landlady's refined manner and her silences.
Analyse how the landlady's questions about skin colour expose racial prejudice.

topics.title: The speaker's wit and the ending

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the speaker uses words such as 'sepia', 'brunette' and 'peroxide blonde' humorously.
Evaluate the satirical effect of the speaker's closing question.
Identify the colour images in the poem and explain their effect.
Interpret wordplay such as 'hide-and-speak' and the use of capital letters.

topics.title: About the poet and the title

concepts.learning_objective: Recall key facts about Wole Soyinka's life, education and achievements.
Evaluate the significance of the title 'Telephone Conversation' and the poet's satirical style.
